nodes.asset_description: A minimalist 3D render shows glossy aqua-blue oval discs clustered beside a purple six-petal asterisk, all floating on a soft gray gradient. Subtle neon glows and smooth plastic textures give the composition a sleek, modern feel.

The image shows the word “Design” in large 3D sans‑serif letters with a lavender-to-magenta gradient and a soft neon glow. Centered on a smooth gray background, the text casts long diagonal shadows, giving a clean, minimalist look.

A neon-style, purple gradient pill-shaped button sits centered on a black background, glowing with a soft halo. It reads “READ MORE” in bold white fading to translucent purple toward the right, ending with a white checkmark icon.

A modern webinar poster with bold dark‑teal “LIVE WEBINAR” text over a grayscale office background, contrasted by a warm orange gradient circle framing a smiling speaker on the right. Left-aligned details and a red “Live Streaming” badge complete the clean, balanced composition.
